beats.narration: What I learned: Google's effective figure is for E2B, one point nine one billion. There's no E4B figure in the docs, so the chart says which model each number belongs to. Still open: two patterns have no vertical twin.

props.heading: Week 7 — learned and open

moves.label: LEARNED
moves.detail: The docs give an effective figure for E2B — 1.91B of over 5B loaded — not for E4B.

moves.label: CHECKED
moves.detail: The PLE table is 2.35B of 8.39B — 28% — so the draft's “almost a third” was dropped.

moves.label: OPEN
moves.detail: ClaudeScienceLayerStack and ClaudeCodeBeat still have no 9:16 twin.

moves.label: NEXT
moves.detail: Next week's teardown, built the same way.
